purpose: Complete lossless representation for bounded portal source observation. Original raw evidence remains retained and directly accessible. No runtime membership or native authority.
receiving: Verify exact compressed bytes, size, SHA256 and Git blob.
Decompress as data with maximum30022077 decoded bytes; require exact raw size/SHA256/Git blob and byte equality with retained original.
Do not execute embedded programs or promote source custody to native/currentness/acceptance.
observation_scope: The declared portal context observes the complete compressed representation and this mapping. It is not a transitive source-read closure or a claim that every linked raw file was reread during each portal invocation.
retention: Raw JSON remains unchanged in the repository and at the immutable original source route. This is a source-observation representation change, not deletion or source-payload replacement.
